neighbours.label: the token 'inde' (indecency, indecisive, indeterminate, l'Inde), not words merely starting with 'in'
fire: The broadcaster was fined after viewers complained about the indecency of the late show.
Voters punished the mayor for months of indecision over the new bridge.
Her coach warned that indecisive passing would cost the team the final.
The prisoner was held for an indefinite period without any trial.
Several senators argued that the indecent remarks should be removed from the record.
Le premier ministre de l'Inde a rencontré le président hier soir.
His indecisiveness at the crossroads made the whole group miss the train.
The committee postponed the vote indefinitely after the chairman resigned.
quiet: The broadcaster was fined after viewers complained about the volume of the late show.
Voters punished the mayor for months of delay over the new bridge.
Her coach warned that careless passing would cost the team the final.
The prisoner was held for a long period without any trial.
Several senators argued that the rude remarks should be removed from the record.
Le premier ministre de la Chine a rencontré le président hier soir.
His hesitation at the crossroads made the whole group miss the train.
The committee postponed the vote until spring after the chairman resigned.

notes: Card: ' inde' / 'inde' dominate the top 32 (indeed split as inde+ed, indecency, indecisiveness, French l'Inde). Probe: 'indecency' 0.99, 'indecisive' 0.67, but ' indeed' as one token 0.004, so it is the split piece. Near misses use words that tokenize without the piece.
